title: Text swap
description: A new thought, without a hard cut.
docs: Import { TextSwap } from your configured components alias under bera/text-swap. Keep its companion CSS. Connect the status index with value; supply statuses with text and icons. Keep a single polite announcement for a meaningful change. Defaults: preview=false, speed=1; radius does not apply. Tested with React 19 and shadcn 4.21.0; use complete CSS color tokens.
